urgency_hints.this_week: For urgent needs (production issue, time-sensitive launch), book a 15-min same-week slot. I prioritize these in my calendar.
urgency_hints.flexible: For exploratory conversations (scope of work, fit assessment), the 30-min slot gives space to map your situation. Slots typically 1-2 weeks out.

first_step_hint: Bring a concrete problem (not 'tell me about Claude Code'). The call is a 15-min screen share where I show my running system as it maps to your situation, then we decide if a paid engagement makes sense.
